purpose: Provide one owner-local deterministic execution surface for TRANSVERSAL_README validation using an authority inventory snapshot supplied by the caller.

input_contract.inventory_json_role: Read-only snapshot of public.lf_activos transversal inventory rows produced by an authorized caller.

ownership_invariants: The owner runner validates a supplied read-only inventory snapshot and does not acquire database credentials.
The canonical validator remains validate_active_shared_readmes_v1.py; this runner does not duplicate README policy.
The caller is responsible for producing a current authorized inventory snapshot and preserving its evidence/currentness.
Historical placement inside Validate LF Packs is not ownership authority.
